leadStory.headline: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease
leadStory.standfirst: FDA reports on what may be the most significant AI development this week in the pharma and regulatory space.
leadStory.body: FDA today approved Infilbray (venglustat) tablets, the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3) in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg (approximately 33 pounds).

sources.title: FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease
